class.name: NNBTBlackboardHas
class.brief_description: Condition leaf that checks whether a blackboard key is set.
class.description: Returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] if [member key] exists in the tree's blackboard with a non-[code]null[/code] value, and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] otherwise. Use to guard a branch until a target or flag has been populated (for example, after [NNBTRunNQSQuery]).
